parsed.reason: Short, plain, and gets Ben and his age right. "One little one on the list" adds a slight flourish and implies a list, which is mildly invented, but it is not a new fact about the child. "Got it - Ben is 2" reads a bit like repeating the data back, and "little one" is a touch cutesy, but it stays quiet and doesn't ask anything or promise anything. Slightly more padded than needed for "ben 2".
